exposure: Gestational age at appendectomy (≤ 20 weeks vs. > 20 weeks)
cohort: Pregnant women with or without appendectomy at South Stockholm General Hospital, December 2015 to February 2021, and a control group of non-pregnant women of fertile age during the same time period
finding: Routine laparoscopic surgery and time priority for pregnant surgery is associated with a low risk of appendix perforation, preterm birth and other complications.
mod_finding: This study found no differences in the proportion of preterm delivery, small-for-gestational age, or Cesarean delivery between women with or without appendectomy during pregnancy.
